title: Generator identity for base localization comparison
statement: Under the compatible ring, algebra, scalar tower, derived category, localization, complex, and model hypotheses of lem-pc-base-localization-comparison, and for an ordinary-complex isomorphism tau satisfying the displayed tensor-generator formula, the composite L.localizedComparison i followed by HomologicalComplex.homologyMap tau.hom i sends every element 1 tensor x to K.localizedComparison i applied to 1 tensor the canonical base-localization cohomology map of x.

source.place: Tag 0DJ8 affine localization identity; Tag 06Y6 universal counit and localization tensor identity

proof.text: Obtain the actual ordinary localization chain map psi, its generator formula and its ordinary comparison square from exists_baseLocalization_ordinaryComparison. Evaluate both localized_eq equations on x and on its canonical base-localization image; the extension/restriction unit sends each element to 1 tensor that element. Apply baseTensorLocalization_homology_naturality at L.comparison(x), substitute the ordinary comparison square and cancel the K restriction homology isomorphism and its inverse. The resulting equality is the stated generator identity. All three declarations are proved without sorry.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0DJ8, lemma-single-complex-base-change-condition, affine localization identity; More on Algebra, Tag 06Y6, lemma-derived-base-change, universal derived tensor comparison.
proof_origin.note: The explicit universal-counit and exact-homology calculations are proved in Lean; the unit route is unchanged.
